snippet.title: Gameplay Trailer - Blade Dodger
snippet.description:
Spiff, just an ordinary guy, has been thrown into a world of danger and mystery. His only chance to escape is to do whatever it takes to survive the onslaught of blades, obstacles, and cast of characters doing everything to stop him.
